section.content: 本公开涉及机器学习装置。机器学习车辆(2)特有的学习模型的机器学习装置具备：使用包含由设置于车辆的检测器检测出的状态参数的值的训练数据集进行学习模型的机器学习的学习部(146、333)；以及在由检测器检测出的状态参数的值发生了异常的情况下取得由其他车辆检测出的状态参数的值的参数值取得部(145、332)。学习部在由检测器检测出的状态参数的值发生了异常的情况下，使用代替由检测器检测出的状态参数的值而包含由参数值取得部从其他车辆取得的值的训练数据集，进行学习模型的机器学习。由此，即使构成训练数据集的状态参数的值发生了异常，也能适当地学习学习模型。

The present disclosure relates to machine learning devices. A machine learning device for machine learning a learning model specific to a vehicle (2) is provided with: a learning unit (146, 333) that performs machine learning of a learning model using a training data set including values of state parameters detected by a detector provided in the vehicle; and a parameter value acquisition unit (145, 332) that acquires the value of the state parameter detected by the other vehicle when the value of the state parameter detected by the detector is abnormal. When the value of the state parameter detected by the detector is abnormal, the learning unit performs machine learning of the learning model using a training data set including values acquired from another vehicle by the parameter value acquisition unit instead of the value of the state parameter detected by the detector. Thus, even if an abnormality occurs in the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set, the learning model can be appropriately learned.

Machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning device that machine-learns a learning model unique to a vehicle.

Background

It is known to perform machine learning of a learning model by acquiring values of state parameters related to a vehicle and using the acquired values of the state parameters as a training data set (for example, patent document 1). In particular, patent document 1 proposes machine learning in which a learning model for outputting the temperature of the exhaust purification catalyst is performed based on a training data set including values such as the engine speed, the engine load factor, and the temperature of the exhaust purification catalyst.

Documents of the prior art

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2019-183698

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

For example, in the case where a sensor detects a value of a state parameter constituting a training data set, if an abnormality occurs in the sensor, the value of the state parameter cannot be accurately detected. When the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set are abnormal, if the learning model is machine-learned using the training data set, the learning model cannot be appropriately learned.

In view of the above-described problems, an object of the present disclosure is to provide a machine learning device capable of appropriately machine-learning a learning model even when an abnormality occurs in a value of a state parameter constituting a training data set used for the machine learning model.

Means for solving the problems

The gist of the present disclosure is as follows.

(1) A machine learning device for machine learning a learning model specific to a vehicle, comprising: a learning unit that learns the learning model using a training data set including values of state parameters detected by a detector provided in the vehicle; and a parameter value acquisition unit that acquires, when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the detector, the value of the state parameter detected by another vehicle under a condition that matches a detection condition when the value of the state parameter included in the training data set is detected by the detector, wherein the learning unit performs learning of the learning model using the training data set that includes the value acquired by the parameter value acquisition unit from another vehicle instead of the value of the state parameter detected by the detector when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the detector.

(2) The machine learning device according to the above (1), which is provided in the vehicle, wherein the parameter value acquisition unit acquires the value of the state parameter detected by the other vehicle through inter-vehicle communication with the other vehicle or through communication with a server capable of communicating with the other vehicle.

(3) The machine learning device according to the above (1), which is provided in a server that can communicate with the vehicle and the other vehicle, and which further includes a model transmission unit that transmits information of a learning model learned by the learning unit to the vehicle, wherein the parameter value acquisition unit acquires, from the other vehicle, a value of the state parameter detected by the other vehicle through communication between the other vehicle and the server, and wherein the learning unit performs learning of the learning model using a training data set that includes the value of the state parameter acquired from the other vehicle and a value of another state parameter other than the state parameter and associated with the vehicle, which is transmitted from the vehicle through communication between the vehicle and the server.

(4) The machine learning device according to any one of the above (1) to (3), wherein the state parameter is a physical quantity that has a smaller difference between vehicles under the same detection condition than other state parameters related to the vehicle.

(5) The machine learning device according to any one of the above (1) to (4), wherein the state parameter is a state parameter associated with an external environment of the vehicle.

(6) The machine learning device according to the above (5), wherein the state parameter includes at least any one of a temperature, a humidity, and an atmospheric pressure of the atmosphere around the vehicle.

(7) The machine learning device according to any one of the above (1) to (6), wherein the detection conditions include a time and a place at which the detector detects the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set of the vehicle.

Effects of the invention

According to the present disclosure, there is provided a machine learning device capable of appropriately machine-learning a learning model even when an abnormality occurs in a value of a state parameter constituting a training data set for the machine learning model.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, embodiments will be described in detail with reference to the drawings. In the following description, the same reference numerals are given to the same components.

< first embodiment >

Constitution of machine learning System

First, a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment will be described with reference to fig. 1 to 7. Fig. 1 is a schematic configuration diagram of a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment. The machine learning system 1 machine-learns a learning model specific to each vehicle using a state parameter indicating a state of each vehicle.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning system 1 includes a plurality of communicable vehicles 2 and a server 3. Each of the plurality of vehicles 2 and the server 3 are configured to be able to communicate with each other via a communication network 4 and a wireless base station 5, the communication network 4 is configured by an optical communication line or the like, and the wireless base station 5 is connected to the communication network 4 via a gateway (not shown). The communication between the vehicle 2 and the wireless base station 5 is communication conforming to an arbitrary communication standard. In the following description, one of the vehicles 2 that uses a learning model that is machine-learned by the machine learning system 1 is referred to as a host vehicle 2a, and vehicles other than the host vehicle 2a are referred to as other vehicles 2 b.

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing the hardware configuration of the vehicle 2. As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 includes an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) 11. The ECU11 has an in-vehicle communication interface 12, a memory 13, and a processor 14. The in-vehicle communication interface 12 and the memory 13 are connected to the processor 14 via signal lines. In the present embodiment, the vehicle 2 is provided with one ECU11, but a plurality of ECUs divided into functions may be provided.

The in-vehicle communication interface 12 has an interface circuit for connecting the ECU11 to the in-vehicle Network 15 conforming to the CAN (Controller Area Network) standard or the like. The ECU11 communicates with other in-vehicle devices via the in-vehicle communication interface 12.

The memory 13 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The memory 13 includes, for example, a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM) and a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM). The memory 13 stores a computer program for executing various processes in the processor 14, various data used when the processor 14 executes various processes, and the like. Thus, the memory 13 stores the learning model.

Processor 14 has one or more cpus (central Processing units) and peripheral circuitry therefor. The processor 14 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a gpu (graphics Processing unit), a logical operation unit, or a numerical operation unit. The processor 14 executes various processes based on the computer program stored in the memory 13. Therefore, when the value of the input parameter of the learning model is input, the processor 14 performs arithmetic processing in accordance with the learning model and outputs the value of the output parameter.

Fig. 3 is a functional block diagram of the processor 14 of the own vehicle 2 a. As shown in fig. 3, the processor 14 includes: a control portion 141 that controls the control device 22 of the host vehicle 2a using a learning model; a data transmission unit 142 that transmits a training data set for machine learning of the learning model to the server 3; and a model updating unit 143 that updates the learning model used by the control unit 141. These functional blocks possessed by the processor 14 are, for example, functional modules realized by a computer program operating on the processor 14. Alternatively, these functional blocks included in the processor 14 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 14. Details of each functional block of the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a will be described later.

As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 further includes an exterior communication module 21, a plurality of control devices 22, and a plurality of sensors 23. The vehicle exterior communication module 21, the control device 22, and the sensor 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the vehicle interior network 15.

The vehicle exterior communication module 21 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with a device outside the vehicle. The vehicle exterior communication module 21 is a device for communicating with the server 3 and the other vehicle 2b, for example. The off-board communication module 21 includes, for example, a Data Communication Module (DCM). The data communication module communicates with the server 3 via the wireless base station 5 and the communication network 4.

The control device 22 is a device that performs various controls related to the vehicle 2. Specifically, the control device 22 includes, for example, a drive actuator of a throttle valve that adjusts an opening degree of the throttle valve provided on an intake passage of the internal combustion engine, an injector that supplies fuel to a combustion chamber of the internal combustion engine, a drive actuator of an EGR valve that controls an EGR rate of the internal combustion engine, a blower of an air conditioning device, a drive actuator of an air mixer door that controls an air flow of the air conditioning device, and the like. These control devices 22 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and operate in accordance with drive signals from the ECU 11.

The sensor 23 is an example of a detector that detects values (state quantities) of various state parameters related to the vehicle 2. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an air amount sensor that detects an amount of intake air supplied to the internal combustion engine, an injection pressure sensor that detects a fuel injection pressure from an injector of the internal combustion engine, an exhaust gas temperature sensor that detects a temperature of exhaust gas (exhaust gas), an input detection sensor that detects an input of a driver on a touch panel or the like, a self position sensor (e.g., GPS) that detects a self position of the vehicle 2, and the like. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an outside air temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the air around the vehicle 2 (outside air temperature), an outside air humidity sensor that detects the humidity of the air around the vehicle 2 (outside air humidity), an atmospheric pressure sensor that detects the atmospheric pressure around the vehicle 2, an inside temperature sensor that detects the temperature in the room of the vehicle 2 (room temperature), an inside humidity sensor that detects the humidity in the room of the vehicle 2 (room humidity), and a solar radiation sensor that detects the amount of solar radiation. These sensors 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and transmit output signals to the ECU 11.

The server 3 is provided outside the vehicle 2, and communicates with the vehicle 2 traveling in a specific area via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5. The server 3 receives various information from the vehicle 2 traveling in a specific area.

Fig. 4 is a diagram schematically showing the hardware configuration of the server 3. As shown in fig. 4, the server 3 includes an external communication module 31, a storage device 32, and a processor 33. The server 3 may have an input device such as a keyboard and a mouse, and an output device such as a display.

The external communication module 31 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with a device outside the server 3. The external communication module 31 includes an interface circuit for connecting the server 3 to the communication network 4. The external communication module 31 is configured to be able to communicate with each of the plurality of vehicles 2 via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5.

The storage device 32 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The storage device 32 includes, for example, a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Drive (SSD), or an optical recording medium. The storage device 32 stores computer programs for executing various processes by the processor 33, and various data used when the processor 33 executes the various processes.

The processor 33 has one or more CPUs and peripheral circuits thereof. The processor 33 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a GPU, a logical operation unit, or a numerical operation unit. The processor 33 executes various processes based on the computer program stored in the storage device 32. In the present embodiment, the processor 33 of the server 3 functions as a machine learning device that performs machine learning on a learning model.

Fig. 5 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3. As shown in fig. 5, the processor 33 includes: an abnormality parameter determination unit 331 that determines a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred, among the state parameters constituting the training data set sent from the host vehicle 2 a; a parameter value acquisition unit 332 that acquires a value of the abnormal state parameter from another vehicle 2b different from the host vehicle 2 a; a learning unit 333 that performs machine learning of the learning model; and a model transmitting unit 334 that transmits the machine-learned learning model to the host vehicle 2 a. These functional blocks possessed by the processor 33 are, for example, functional modules realized by a computer program operating on the processor 33. Alternatively, these functional blocks included in the processor 33 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 33. Details of each functional block of the processor 33 of the server 3 will be described later.

Study model

In the present embodiment, the control unit 141 of the host vehicle 2a uses a learning model learned by machine learning when controlling the control device 22 mounted on the host vehicle 2 a. In the present embodiment, a Neural Network (NN) model (hereinafter referred to as "NN model") is used as the learning model. Next, an outline of the NN model will be described with reference to fig. 6. Fig. 6 shows an example of an NN model having a simple structure.

The circles in fig. 6 represent artificial neurons. Artificial neurons are generally referred to as nodes or units (referred to as "nodes" in this specification). In fig. 6, L-1 denotes an input layer, L-2 and L-3 denote hidden layers (or intermediate layers), and L-4 denotes an output layer.

As described above, the NN model includes an input layer, a hidden layer, and an output layer, and when one or more input parameters are input from the input layer, one or more output parameters corresponding to the input parameters are output from the output layer.

In the present embodiment, as such a learning model, for example, a model is used which outputs the temperature of the exhaust gas as the value of the output parameter when the outside air temperature, the intake air amount, the fuel injection timing, the fuel injection pressure, and the EGR rate are input as the values of the input parameters. The control unit 141 of the host vehicle 2a outputs the temperature of the exhaust gas by inputting the values of the input parameters detected by the sensor 23 into the learning model. The control portion 141 controls the control device 22 relating to the internal combustion engine based on the output temperature of the exhaust gas. Here, since the exhaust gas temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the exhaust gas has a response delay, if the internal combustion engine is controlled based on the output of the exhaust gas temperature sensor, the internal combustion engine cannot necessarily be controlled appropriately. In contrast, since the temperature of the exhaust gas is calculated using the learning model without delay, the internal combustion engine can be controlled more appropriately by controlling the internal combustion engine using the temperature of the exhaust gas calculated using the learning model.

Alternatively, as such a learning model, for example, a model may be used which outputs a target temperature of the air conditioner as a value of an output parameter when an outside air temperature, an inside humidity, and a solar radiation amount are input as values of input parameters. In this case, the control unit 141 of the host vehicle 2a outputs the target temperature of the air conditioner by inputting the values of the input parameters detected by the sensor 23 to the learning model. The ECU11 controls the control device 22 relating to the air conditioner so that the vehicle interior temperature becomes the target temperature output from the learning model.

Further, as the learning model, various models can be used. Therefore, as the input parameters, various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as the outside air temperature, the outside air humidity, the atmospheric pressure, the indoor temperature, the indoor humidity, the solar radiation amount, the intake air temperature, the fuel injection pressure, the fuel injection timing, the fuel injection amount, the air-fuel ratio, the ignition timing, the engine cooling water temperature, and the supercharging pressure, can be used. Various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as the temperature of the exhaust purification catalyst, the concentration of NOx in the exhaust gas, the output torque of the internal combustion engine, and the humidity of the vehicle interior, can be used as the output parameters.

Basic learning of learning model

Next, machine learning of the learning model (NN model) as described above will be described. In order to improve the accuracy of the NN model, it is necessary to perform machine learning of the NN model. In the present embodiment, the learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the NN model. First, a method of learning the NN model performed by the learning unit 333 will be briefly described.

In the machine learning of the NN model, a training data set including values of state parameters detected by the sensors 23 provided in the vehicle 2 is used. The training data set is composed of a combination of a plurality of measured values of a plurality of input parameters and a plurality of measured values (positive solution data) of at least one output parameter corresponding to the measured values. In the present embodiment, the actual measurement values of the input parameters and the actual measurement values of the output parameters are values detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a or control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 22. In the present embodiment, when the server 3 performs the machine learning of the NN model, actual measurement values used as a training data set are transmitted from the own vehicle 2a to the server 3.

The learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs preprocessing (normalization, and the like) on the training data set transmitted from the own vehicle 2a, and then performs machine learning of the NN model. In the machine learning of the NN model, the learning unit 333 repeatedly updates the weights w and the biases b in the NN model by a known error inverse propagation method, for example, so that the difference between the output value of the NN model and the actual measurement value of the output parameter included in the training data set is small. As a result, the NN model is learned, and a learned NN model is generated. The information of the learned NN model (the structure of the model, the weight w, the offset b, and the like) is stored in the storage device 32 of the server, and is transmitted from the server 3 to the own vehicle 2 a.

Learning when abnormality occurs in the value of the State parameter

When an abnormality such as a failure occurs in the sensor 23 that detects the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set, an error occurs in the output of the sensor 23, or the sensor 23 does not output a signal. If the machine learning of the learning model is performed using the output of the sensor 23 in which the abnormality has occurred in this way, the machine learning of the learning model cannot be appropriately performed.

In the present embodiment, when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23, the value of the state parameter is acquired from another vehicle 2b in the same area as the host vehicle 2a, and the learning model is machine-learned using a training data set including the value acquired from the other vehicle 2b instead of the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23. Hereinafter, machine learning of the learning model when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 will be specifically described with reference to fig. 7.

Fig. 7 is an operation sequence diagram of the learning process performed by the machine learning system 1. In particular, fig. 7 is an operation timing chart when the learning model used when controlling the control device 22 of the host vehicle 2a is machine-learned when an abnormality occurs in the outside air temperature sensor of the host vehicle 2 a.

As shown in fig. 7, the other vehicle 2b periodically detects the value of the state parameter including the outside air temperature and the detection condition at that time (step S11). The value of the state parameter is detected by the sensor 23 of the other vehicle 2 b. In particular, the outside air temperature among the state parameters is detected by an outside air temperature sensor. The detection condition indicates a condition when the sensor 23 detects the value of each state parameter, and in the present embodiment, includes a time and a place at which the value of each state parameter is detected. The time at which the value of each state parameter is detected is acquired from the ECU11 of the other vehicle 2b that functions as a clock. The position sensor detects the position at which the value of each state parameter is detected. The detection condition may include various other conditions such as the precipitation amount detected by the rain sensor and the model of the vehicle.

The processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b causes the memory 13 to store the values of the detected state parameters and the detection conditions under which the state parameters are detected. The data transmission unit 142 of the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the detection condition stored in the memory 13 and the type of the detected state parameter to the server 3 via the vehicle-exterior communication module 21 at regular time intervals. The server 3 stores the received detection conditions and the types of the status parameters in the storage device 32.

On the other hand, the own vehicle 2a periodically detects the value of the state parameter used for the machine learning model and the detection condition at that time (step S12). The value of the state parameter is detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2a, and the detection condition is acquired from the ECU11 or detected by the sensor 23. In the example shown in fig. 7, since an abnormality occurs in the outside air temperature sensor of the host vehicle 2a, a large error occurs in the outside air temperature detected by the outside air temperature sensor.

The processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a stores the time-series values of the plurality of detected state parameters and the detection conditions for detecting the respective values of the state parameters in the memory 13. When the values of the state parameters of the number necessary for machine learning are detected and stored in the memory 13, the data transmission unit 142 of the host vehicle 2a transmits the time-series values of the plurality of state parameters stored in the memory 13 to the server 3 as a training data set, and transmits the detection conditions of the respective values of the state parameters to the server 3. The server 3 stores the received training data set and the detection conditions in the storage device 32. The data transmission unit 142 of the host vehicle 2a may transmit the values of the state parameters and the detection conditions to the server 3 each time they are detected.

When the values of the state parameters of the number necessary for machine learning are stored in the storage device 32 as the training data set, the abnormal parameter determination unit 331 of the server 3 determines whether or not there is a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred in the training data set, and if there is a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred, determines the state parameter (step S13). The abnormal parameter determination unit 331 determines that an abnormality has occurred in the value of the state parameter when the value of the state parameter is a value at which such an abnormality is unlikely to occur (for example, when it is detected that the outside air temperature exceeds 50 ℃ in winter), when the value of the state parameter is fixed to a fixed value (for example, when it is detected that the outside air temperature is fixed to 25 ℃ during the day), or when the value of the state parameter is defective because no signal is output from the sensor. When the abnormal parameter determination unit 331 determines that there is no state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred, the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning model in step S16 described later.

In the present embodiment, the abnormality parameter determination unit 331 of the server 3 determines the parameter in which the abnormality has occurred. However, the parameter in which the abnormality has occurred may be determined by other methods. For example, when the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a can diagnose a failure of the sensor 23 mounted on the host vehicle 2a, the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 diagnosed as having a failure may be determined as the state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred. In this case, the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a functions as the abnormality parameter determination unit 331, and the data transmission unit 142 transmits the type of the parameter in which the abnormality has occurred to the server 3 in addition to the value of the state parameter and the detection condition.

When the abnormality parameter determination unit 331 determines the state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred (hereinafter referred to as "abnormality occurrence state parameter". in the example shown in fig. 7, the outside air temperature), the parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the other vehicle 2 b. In particular, in the present embodiment, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 acquires, from the other vehicle 2b, the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under the condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set is detected in the own vehicle 2 a.

Therefore, when it is determined that the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 is abnormal, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 identifies the other vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter (step S14). The parameter value acquisition unit 332 searches for another vehicle 2b that has transmitted a detection condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is detected in the own vehicle 2a, from among the many other vehicles 2b that have transmitted the detection condition. Specifically, for example, the other vehicle 2b, which has detected the state parameter at the time and point at which the value of the state parameter included in the training data set is detected in the own vehicle 2a at the highest degree of matching with the time and point, is determined as the other vehicle 2b which is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter.

When the other vehicle 2b that has acquired the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is identified, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 requests the other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter (i.e., the outside air temperature). In particular, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 transmits a signal requesting the other vehicle 2b specified to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected under the detection condition matching the detection condition of the training data set to the other vehicle 2b via the external communication module 31.

When the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b is requested to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, the processor acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected under the detection condition matching the detection condition of the training data set from the memory 13 (step S15). The processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the acquired value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the server 3 via the vehicle-exterior communication module 21. The parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b via the communication with the server 3 and the other vehicle 2b in this manner. Therefore, when an abnormality occurs in the value of a certain state parameter (abnormality occurrence state parameter) detected by the sensor 23, the parameter value acquisition unit 332 of the server 3 acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under the condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter included in the training data set of the own vehicle 2a is detected by the sensor 23.

The learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning model using the training data set created by the own vehicle 2a and/or the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter transmitted from the other vehicle 2b (step S16). When the abnormality parameter determination unit 331 determines that there is no state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred, the learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the learning model by the above-described learning method using only the training data set sent from the own vehicle 2 a. On the other hand, when the abnormality occurrence state parameter is specified by the abnormality parameter specifying unit 331, the learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the learning model by the above-described learning method using a training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquiring unit 332 instead of the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2 a. In other words, in this case, the learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the learning model using a training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquisition unit 332 and the value of the other state parameter other than the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2a and transmitted from the host vehicle 2 a. Specifically, in the present embodiment, the training data set includes data of the atmospheric temperature acquired by the parameter value acquisition unit 332 from the other vehicle 2b instead of the data of the atmospheric temperature detected by the atmospheric temperature sensor of the host vehicle 2a, and also includes data of other state parameters (for example, an intake air amount and a fuel injection pressure) detected by other sensors (for example, an air amount sensor and an injection pressure sensor) of the host vehicle 2a and/or data of other state parameters (for example, a fuel injection amount and a fuel injection timing) as control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 22.

When the machine learning of the learning model is completed, the learning unit 333 stores the information of the learned learning model in the storage device 32 of the server 3. When the machine learning of the learning model is completed, the model transmitting unit 334 of the server 3 transmits the information (for example, the updated weight w and/or offset b) of the learned learning model to the host vehicle 2 a.

When receiving the information on the learned learning model, the model updating unit 143 of the host vehicle 2a updates the information on the learning model stored in the memory 13 of the host vehicle 2a (step S17). Thus, when the control unit 141 controls the control device 22 using the learning model, the control unit controls the control device 22 based on the updated learning model.

Effect and modification

According to the above embodiment, for example, when an abnormality such as a failure occurs in the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2a and an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set, machine learning of the learning model is performed using the training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b in place of the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter in which the abnormality has occurred. As a result, according to the above embodiment, even if the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2a is abnormal, machine learning of the learning model can be performed using a training data set in which the value of the state parameter is relatively accurate. Therefore, even when an abnormality occurs in the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set used for the machine learning model, the machine learning model can be appropriately machine-learned.

In the present embodiment, the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning model. Therefore, since it is not necessary to perform the learning process with a high calculation load in the host vehicle 2a, it is not necessary to set the processing capability of the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a too high, and thus the manufacturing cost of the host vehicle 2a can be reduced.

In the above-described embodiment, an example is shown in which the machine learning of the learning model is performed when the outside air temperature detected by the outside air temperature sensor is abnormal due to a failure of the outside air temperature sensor. However, the learning method of the learning model described above can also be applied to a case where the sensor 23 other than the outside air temperature sensor is broken and the value of the state parameter other than the outside air temperature is abnormal.

In particular, the learning method of the learning model described above can be applied to a case where the value of the state parameter indicating the same value is abnormal even if the vehicle 2 is different under the same detection condition. Therefore, the learning method of the learning model as described above can be applied to the following cases: among the state parameters related to the host vehicle 2a, a state parameter indicating a physical quantity in which the difference between the vehicles 2 under the same detection condition is smaller than that of the other state parameters is detected when there is an abnormality in the value detected by the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2 a. In particular, since the external environment around the host vehicle 2a is detected to be almost the same between the host vehicle 2a and the other vehicle 2b around the host vehicle 2a, the learning method of the learning model as described above can be applied to a case where the value of the state parameter relating to the external environment around the host vehicle 2a detected by the sensor 23 of the host vehicle 2a is abnormal. Examples of such state parameters include the atmospheric temperature around the host vehicle 2a, and the humidity and the atmospheric pressure of the atmosphere around the host vehicle 2 a.

In the above embodiment, the other vehicle 2b transmits the type of the state parameter and the detection condition detected in step S11 to the server 3. However, the other vehicle 2b may transmit the value of the state parameter and the detection condition detected in step S11 to the server 3. In this case, the values of the state parameters detected in the other vehicle 2b are stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3. Therefore, when the other vehicle 2b is specified in step S14, the server 3 acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b from the storage device 32 without requesting the other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter.

The learning model to be machine-learned by the server 3 may be a machine learning model other than a neural network, such as a random forest, a k-nearest neighbor method, or a support vector machine.

< second embodiment >

Next, the machine learning system 1 according to the second embodiment will be described with reference to fig. 8 to 10. Hereinafter, differences from the machine learning system according to the first embodiment will be mainly described.

In the present embodiment, the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a functions as a machine learning device that performs machine learning on a learning model. Fig. 8 is a functional block diagram of the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a according to the second embodiment. As shown in fig. 8, the processor 14 includes: a control portion 141 that controls the control device 22 of the host vehicle 2a using a learning model; an abnormality parameter determination unit 144 that determines a state parameter in which an abnormality has occurred among the state parameters constituting the training data set created by the host vehicle 2 a; a parameter value acquisition unit 145 that acquires a value of the abnormal state parameter from another vehicle 2b different from the host vehicle 2 a; a learning unit 146 for learning a learning model; and a model updating unit 143 that updates the learning model used by the control unit 141.

Fig. 9 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3 according to the second embodiment. As shown in fig. 9, the processor 33 includes: a vehicle specifying unit 335 that specifies another vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence parameter; and a parameter value transmitting unit 336 for transmitting the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b to the host vehicle 2 a.

Fig. 10 is an operation sequence diagram of the learning process performed by the machine learning system 1 according to the second embodiment. In particular, fig. 10 is an operation timing chart when the learning model for controlling the control device 22 of the host vehicle 2a is subjected to machine learning when an abnormality occurs in the outside air temperature sensor of the host vehicle 2 a.

As shown in fig. 10, the other vehicle 2b periodically detects the value of the state parameter including the outside air temperature and the detection condition at that time, as in step S11 of fig. 7, and stores the detected value in the memory 13 (step S21). The data transmission unit 142 of the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the detection condition stored in the memory 13 and the type of the detected state parameter to the server 3 via the vehicle-exterior communication module 21 at regular time intervals.

On the other hand, similarly to step S12 of fig. 7, the own vehicle 2a periodically detects the values of the state parameters for machine learning of the learning model and the detection conditions at that time, and stores them in the memory 13 (step S22). When the values of the state parameters of the number necessary for learning are detected and stored in the memory 13, the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a creates a training data set by summarizing the time-series values of the plurality of state parameters stored in the memory 13.

When the training data set is created, the abnormality parameter determination unit 144 of the processor 14 of the host vehicle 2a determines whether or not there is a state parameter (abnormality occurrence state parameter) in which an abnormality has occurred in the training data set, and determines the state parameter when there is an abnormality occurrence state parameter (outside air temperature in this example) (step S23), as in step S13 of fig. 7.

When the abnormality occurrence state parameter is specified by the abnormality parameter specifying unit 144, the parameter value acquiring unit 145 of the host vehicle 2a acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the other vehicle 2 b. In particular, in the present embodiment, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 acquires, from the other vehicle 2b, the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under the condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the state parameter constituting the training data set is detected in the own vehicle 2 a.

Therefore, first, when determining that the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 is abnormal, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 transmits the type of the abnormal state parameter and the detection condition to the server 3.

When the type of the abnormality occurrence state parameter and the detection condition are transmitted from the host vehicle 2a, the vehicle identification unit 335 of the server 3 identifies another vehicle 2b that is to acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, in the same manner as in step S14 of fig. 7 (step S24). The vehicle specifying unit 335 searches for another vehicle 2b that transmitted the detection condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is detected in the own vehicle 2a, from among the many other vehicles 2b that transmitted the detection condition. When the other vehicle 2b that has acquired the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter is identified, the vehicle identification unit 335 requests the other vehicle 2b to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter (i.e., outside air temperature).

When the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b is requested to transmit the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter, the processor acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected under the detection condition matching the detection condition of the training data set from the memory 13, in the same manner as in step S15 of fig. 7 (step S25). Then, the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b transmits the acquired value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the server 3. When receiving the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the other vehicle 2b, the parameter value transmitting unit 336 of the server 3 transmits the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the own vehicle 2 a. The parameter value acquisition unit 145 of the host vehicle 2a acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b through the communication between the host vehicle 2a and the server 3 capable of communicating with the other vehicle 2b in this manner. Therefore, when an abnormality occurs in the value of a certain state parameter (abnormality occurrence state parameter) detected by the sensor 23, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 of the host vehicle 2a acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b under the condition that matches the detection condition when the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter included in the training data set of the host vehicle 2a is detected by the sensor 23.

Similarly to step S16 of fig. 7, the learning unit 146 of the host vehicle 2a performs machine learning of the learning model using the training data set created by the host vehicle 2a and/or the values of the abnormality occurrence state parameters transmitted from the other vehicle 2b (step S26). When the abnormality parameter determination unit 144 determines that there is no abnormality occurrence state parameter, the learning unit 146 performs machine learning of the learning model by the above-described learning method using only the training data set created by the own vehicle 2 a. On the other hand, when the abnormality occurrence state parameter is specified by the abnormality parameter specifying unit 144, the learning unit 146 performs machine learning of the learning model by the above-described learning method using a training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquiring unit 145 instead of the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2 a. In other words, in this case, the learning unit 146 performs machine learning of the learning model using a training data set including the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter acquired from the other vehicle 2b by the parameter value acquisition unit 145 and the value of the state parameter other than the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the sensor 23 of the own vehicle 2 a.

When the machine learning of the learning model is completed, the model updating unit 143 of the host vehicle 2a updates the information (for example, the weight w and/or the offset b) of the learning model stored in the memory 13 of the host vehicle 2a (step S27). Thus, when the control unit 141 controls the control device 22 using the learning model, the control unit controls the control device 22 based on the updated learning model.

Effect and modification

In the present embodiment, the machine learning of the learning model is performed in the host vehicle 2 a. If the server 3 performs machine learning of the learning models of all the vehicles 2, the calculation load on the server 3 becomes extremely high, but in the present embodiment, since the machine learning of the learning models is performed by the host vehicle 2a, the calculation load on the server 3 can be reduced.

In the above embodiment, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 of the host vehicle 2a acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b through communication between the host vehicle 2a and the server 3 that can communicate with the other vehicle 2 b. However, the parameter value acquisition unit 145 of the host vehicle 2a may acquire the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter detected by the other vehicle 2b via inter-vehicle communication between the host vehicle 2a and the other vehicle 2 b. In this case, when the processor 14 of the other vehicle 2b acquires the value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter from the memory 13 in step S25, it directly transmits the acquired value of the abnormality occurrence state parameter to the host vehicle 2a via the inter-vehicle communication.
